comment: IEEE 802.15.4 2.4 GHz O-QPSK PHY: 4 bits pick one of 16 32-chip sequences, even chips on I and odd on Q, half-sine pulses, Q half a symbol late. 2 Mchip/s. There is no carrier estimator for a staggered signal yet, so the carrier must come off before this profile (or the source)
